headline: Buenos Aires Bank Opens Neuquén Office to Finance Vaca Muerta Energy Sector
summary: A Buenos Aires-based bank inaugurated an office at the Scientific and Technological Pole in Neuquén to finance the local energy sector and its supply chain with specialized credit lines.
why: Regional bank expansion into energy hubs provides dedicated financing to support capital expenditures in shale and oilfield developments.

impacts.name: Argentine Energy Sector
impacts.why: New credit lines target energy companies and their supply chain in the Vaca Muerta region.
